title: Willie Hightower, who played ragtime and went to Chicago
summary: Vincent recalls Willie Hightower playing with different groups before leaving for Chicago, and playing ragtime, though few could read it then.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: What about Willie Hightower? He's been, uh, you might have known him after Chicago. I know him, yeah. Well, he used to play with different fellows. He used to get that trumpet player too, before he left here, you know. The kid used to play around with different fellows, you know. Ask him, did he play ragtime?
So did he play ragtime? Yeah, yeah, he used to play ragtime. I was trying to remember if he could read it, you know. Very few of them was reading then. Yeah, he wasn't about to have him.
